subject: Runway endorsement request: GPU commit validation for Nebula Labs deal
messages:
From: Elena Voss <elena@nebulalabs.com>
To: avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Runway endorsement request: GPU commit validation for Nebula Labs deal

Hi Avery / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Nebula is excited and we're preparing the procurement packet for the Q4 launch. Before Procurement starts the formal paperwork we need a short internal confirmation from Redwood: a written endorsement that the requested GPU runway (estimated 40 A100-equivalent slots, sustained for a 12-week ramp) is available to support Nebula's committed throughput and the proposed go-live window.

Attached is a short brief with our expected concurrency and peak-sequence lengths (nebula_request_brief.pdf). We'd like to get a soft approval or a runway hold by July 14 so procurement can include the capacity contingency in our contract.

Can you confirm next steps and whether Redwood can place a provisional hold while we finalize terms? If helpful, Procurement is copied on thread.

Thanks,
Elena Voss
Head of Infrastructure
Nebula Labs
elena@nebulalabs.com

Attachments: nebula_request_brief.pdf

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Nebula's request. Elena asked for a short written endorsement and (ideally) a provisional hold while procurement runs their process. Please treat this as a late-stage deal runway ask: deal NEB-2027-4375 in HubSpot.

Quick asks for ops:
- Can you validate whether 40 A100-equivalent slots for a 12-week sustained ramp are available for the requested window?
- Recommend whether we should apply a soft hold and the recommended hold amount (units / start date / contingency).
- If ops needs an engineering check, loop in Infra Scheduling or provide an ETA.

Attachments I’m sharing: fleet_snapshot_20270710.csv (ops snapshot) and capacity_snapshot_Q3.csv (recent utilization). Also linking the HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/NEB-2027-4375

If we can get an endorsement note (one paragraph) we can send it to Procurement and get the DocuSign thread started.

Thanks — Avery
Avery Johnson

Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Elena Voss <elena@nebulalabs.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runway endorsement request: GPU commit validation for Nebula Labs deal

Avery / Marissa / Elena —

Thanks for the context and the brief. I pulled the fleet snapshot (attached) and ran a quick slot-level availability check for the proposed Q4 window. High level:
- Current spare A100-equivalent capacity across US regions: ~62 slots (based on utilization baselines and expected churn in July/August).
- Contention risks: two large reserved commitments in late August that could reduce usable free capacity by ~12 slots during mid-September; we can mitigate by routing Nebula to mixed-quantized variants for non-critical stages.

Recommendation:
- Apply a provisional soft hold of 36 slots starting 2027-08-01 with a 30-day review clause. That gives Nebula runway for their 12-week ramp while leaving a small buffer for unexpected churn.
- Ops to file formal hold via soft_hold_form.pdf (attached). If legal needs a hard guarantee we should convert to a reserved capacity quote and escalate to Dedicated contracts.

I'll flag capacity scheduling and put a temp hold on the 36 slots pending final approval from Sales Ops. Next steps for Sales: confirm you want me to activate the soft hold and I'll file the internal ticket and provide the one-paragraph endorsement for Procurement.

Ben Carter
Capacity & Sales Ops Liaison
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: fleet_snapshot_20270710.csv, soft_hold_form.pdf
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Voss <elena@nebulalabs.com>, Procurement <procurement@nebulalabs.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runway endorsement request: GPU commit validation for Nebula Labs deal

Elena / Procurement —

Appreciate the patience. Per Ben's validation: Redwood can provisionally hold 36 A100-equivalent slots beginning 2027-08-01 with a 30-day review. Ben has filed the internal soft-hold ticket and attached the completed soft_hold_form.pdf for your records.

For Procurement: we can include a capacity contingency clause in the MSA and route the final signature via DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docusign/NEB-2027-4375. If Nebula is comfortable, we propose a 15-minute alignment call tomorrow to confirm start date and the contingency window. I’ll send a calendar invite if that works.

Proposed one-paragraph endorsement (for your legal file):
"Redwood Inference confirms provisional availability to provision up to 36 A100-equivalent GPU slots to support Nebula Labs' Q4 ramp, effective 2027-08-01, subject to a 30-day operational review and standard ordering terms.
"

If you want Ben to convert the provisional hold into a reserved capacity quote, say the word and we’ll escalate to Contracts.

Thanks —
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: soft_hold_form.pdf
